new_results.statement: For the live two-star packet, (eta_L eta_R)^4 <= 4 Z_L Z_R/delta^2. After both physical E3 exits fail at Z_L,Z_R<2^-18 and delta>=2/9, eta_L eta_R<3/512; opposite off-plane leakage product is also <3/512.

For distinct anchors, with B=[[N,u],[v^T,b]], delta=||u||||v|| and F=||P_u^perp N P_v^perp||_F, the aggregate bordered 3-minor packet obeys |delta F-|b|sqrt(E2(N))| <= sqrt(D_pq) <= delta F+|b|sqrt(E2(N)). Thus after E3(B)<2^-18, either |b|sqrt(E2(N))>=2^-9 or F<9/512; at b=0, F<9/1024.
